options.name: filter_ipv6
options.description: Whether to filter IPv6 traffic as well. IPv4 traffic is always filtered, IPv6 traffic filtering needs to be explicitly enabled.

options.name: hetzner_password
options.description: The password for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: hetzner_user
options.description: The username for the Robot web-service user.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting when rate limit exceeded errors are returned. Set to V(0) to not retry. Set to a negative value like V(-1) to retry forever.

options.name: server_ip
options.description: The server's main IP address. Exactly one of O(server_ip) and O(server_number) must be specified. Note that Hetzner deprecated identifying the server's firewall by the server's main IP. Using this option can thus stop working at any time in the future. Use O(server_number) instead.

options.name: server_number
options.description: The server's number. Exactly one of O(server_ip) and O(server_number) must be specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Status of the firewall. Firewall is active if state is V(present), and disabled if state is V(absent).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for waiting for firewall to be configured.

options.name: update_timeout
options.description: Timeout to use when configuring the firewall. Note that the API call returns before the firewall has been successfully set up.

options.name: wait_delay
options.description: Delay to wait (in seconds) before checking again whether the firewall has been configured.

options.name: wait_for_configured
options.description: Whether to wait until the firewall has been successfully configured before determining what to do, and before returning from the module. The API returns status C(in progress) when the firewall is currently being configured. If this happens, the module will try again until the status changes to C(active) or C(disabled).
